verdict.rationale: Fern Agent is a first-party agent that reads the docs repository and makes the changes you describe from a prompt, including via Slack. It can also run on a schedule to review reader feedback, unanswered questions, search queries or analytics, then open a pull request when a change is requested. missing for 10: no evidence of the agent being triggered by or reviewing a PR, no evidence of review of the docs content itself (scheduled review covers feedback and analytics), no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a platform AI agent drafts, updates, and reviews my docs — from a prompt, a PR, or a schedule — and ships its work as change requests

citations.quote: Fern Agent reads your docs site’s source repository and makes the changes you describe.
You can now put Fern Agent on a schedule
Automations can review your reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, or analytics, report back what it found, and open a pull request when the prompt asks for a change.
Slack to kick off PRs based on internal team discussions or customer troubleshooting
